The probe was trained on examples of Qwen3.5-27B's own replies. It reads Qwen3.5-27B's internal activations (layer 48) at every token of the reply and gives each token a score in log-odds (higher = more like doing arithmetic). The reply's score is the peak of a running average of the per-token log-odds x_t: s_t = 0.5 * x_t + 0.5 * s_(t-1), starting from s_0 = 0; the reply score is the highest s_t. So the running average must stay low everywhere, and the first token alone gives s_1 = x_1 / 2.
